Short title and commencement

ACT XVIII OF 2016
ACT
XVIII OF 2016
PUNJAB
EDUCATION FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016
An
Act to amend the Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary, 4th March, 2016]
No. PAP/Legis-2(110)/2016/1390,
dated 4-3-2016.---The Punjab Education Foundation (Amendment)
Bill 2015, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on
February 26, 2016, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on March 3,
2016, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary to amend the Punjab
Education Foundation Act 2004 (XII of 2004) for the purposes hereinafter
appearing.
Be it
enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be cited as the Punjab Education Foundation (Amendment) Act, 2016.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment in section 3 of Act XII of 2004

2. Amendment
in section 3 of Act XII of 2004.---In the said Act, in section
3, for subsection (3), the following shall be substituted:
(3) The Foundation shall have its Headquarter
at Lahore and may, with the approval of the Board, establish regional offices outside Lahore.

Amendment in section 5 of Act XII of 2004

ACT XVIII OF 2016
ACT
XVIII OF 2016
PUNJAB
EDUCATION FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016
An
Act to amend the Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary, 4th March, 2016]
No. PAP/Legis-2(110)/2016/1390,
dated 4-3-2016.---The Punjab Education Foundation (Amendment)
Bill 2015, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on
February 26, 2016, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on March 3,
2016, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary to amend the Punjab
Education Foundation Act 2004 (XII of 2004) for the purposes hereinafter
appearing.
Be it
enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
3. Amendment in section 5 of Act XII of
2004.---In the said Act, in section 5:
(a) for
subsection (2), the following shall be substituted:
(2) The Board shall consist of fifteen
Directors including the Chairperson and Managing Director to be appointed by
the Government in the following manner:
(a) eight
Directors including at least three women from amongst the non-governmental
organizations, philanthropists, technocrats, academicians, parliamentarians and
public representatives;
(b) Secretary
to the Government, Finance Department;
(c) Secretary
to the Government, School Education Department;
(d) Secretary
to the Government, Literacy and Non-Formal Basic Education Department;
(e) Secretary
to the Government, Social Welfare and Bait-ul-Maal Department;
(f) Secretary
to the Government, Planning and Development Department;
(g) Vice
Chancellor, University of Education, Lahore; and
(h) Managing
Director who shall also be the Secretary of the Board.
Explanation.---The members mentioned
from (b) to (f) may be represented by their nominees not below the rank of an
Additional Secretary. ;
(b) for subsection (3), the following shall
be substituted:
(3) The Board shall elect the Chairperson from
amongst the Directors appointed under clause (a) of subsection (2) for a period
of three years. ;
(c) subsection
(5) shall be omitted;
(d) for
subsection (6), the following shall be substituted:
(6) Six Directors including at least three
Directors appointed under clause (a) of subsection (2) shall constitute the
quorum for a meeting. ; and
(e) after
subsection (10), the following subsection (11) shall be inserted:
(11) The Board shall establish an effective
system for monitoring, supervision and control of the discharge of functions
under the Act.

2004.---In the said Act, in section 6:
(a) in
subsection (1), for the word Board , the word Government shall be
substituted; and
(b) after
subsection (2), the following subsection (3) shall be inserted:
(3) The
Board shall determine the terms and conditions of service of the Managing
